grandparents_cupboard.reason: Pork mince, aubergines, tinned tomatoes, dried pasta and Parmesan are all plain whole foods or acceptable staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including rigatoni and fennel seeds, is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan, a saucepan, a knife and a grater, and uses simple frying and simmering.

works.reason: Two aubergines, 400g pork, a tin of tomatoes and 350g rigatoni make a well-seasoned sauce for four, and a splash of pasta water loosens it.

honest_times.reason: About 10 minutes of chopping plus stirring the frying pan fits 15 minutes prep, and the 35 minutes overall matches the 26 minutes of hob steps for a quick dinner.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item, including the fennel seeds, chilli and basil, is used, and the steps add nothing unlisted apart from pasta water.

seasonal_feel.reason: July aubergines are fried golden and make up the bulk of the sauce, so they are clearly the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a proper family pasta with meat, vegetables and tomatoes, which a family would happily eat again.
